# Contributing to OksaSDR

OksaSDR is the mobile FlexRadio client (iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android) in
this repository, built on the AetherSDR engine and maintained by Niko
Oksa, OH6OKSA. Its code is in [`mobile/`](../mobile/) on the
`mobile/oksasdr` branch; the rest of the tree is the AetherSDR engine.

- **Test reports and ideas** help the most: see the
  [tester guide](../docs/mobile/TESTING.md), the
  [roadmap](../mobile/ROADMAP.md) and the
  [issue forms](https://github.com/OH6OKSA/OksaSDR/issues/new/choose).
- **Code:** open an issue first to talk it over. Pull requests go to
  `mobile/oksasdr`; follow the conventions in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)
  and keep the docs in step (`mobile/tools/docs-check.py`, see
  [mobile/README.md](../mobile/README.md#keeping-github-up-to-date)).
  Commits are signed.
- Contributions are licensed under the GPLv3, as the project.

For the desktop AetherSDR, contribute upstream:
https://github.com/aethersdr/AetherSDR/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
